description: Exceptions for npm audit advisories that have been reviewed and accepted.

advisories.title: Vulnerable ONNX Runtime Web Version
advisories.reason: STILL PRESENT after the @huggingface/transformers migration, as a prerelease. @huggingface/transformers@4.3.2 declares onnxruntime-web@1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0 and onnxruntime-common@1.31.0-dev.20260911-2a43ec07e — pre-release builds, not covered by any released-version advisory range. The previous exception was justified by migration removing this dependency; that premise was wrong, so the reason is restated rather than the expiry extended. ALiX loads the Node native binding (onnxruntime-node) for CPU inference, not the web/WASM backend. Prerelease supply-chain exposure still requires an owner decision.
